thread:
Rina: quick pattern review - pulled recurring incidents for the past 3 months. goal: assign fix owners + timelines so we stop repeating the same pages.

DevOpsBot: cluster analysis complete: 22 incidents. Top vectors: pool-saturation (8), deploy-mislabel (6), warmup-failures (4), thirdparty-throttle (4). Dashboard: https://dash/internal/recurrence-3m

Owen: can you paste the short rationale for each cluster?

Rina: sure: pool-saturation -> mostly around model swap windows; deploy-mislabel -> missing pool tags in templated deploys; warmup-failures -> cold-start tail spikes; thirdparty-throttle -> embedding vendor rate limits.

Marta: I can own deploy-mislabel. plan: add a CI linter + post-deploy verifier. ETA 2w.

Luis: I'll take pool-saturation. short-term margin bump during swap windows; long-term autoscaler smoothing. ETA 3w.

Owen: warmup-failures I'll handle. implement pre-warm hook + gauge trigger. ETA 3 wks.

Rina: proposed actions (I'll open tickets and add recurrency notes):
- ACT-181: Pool margin & autoscaler change. Owner: Luis. ETA: 2026-04-12.
- ACT-182: Deploy linter + verifier. Owner: Marta. ETA: 2026-03-30.
- ACT-183: Warmup hook & benchmark. Owner: Owen. ETA: 2026-04-20.
- ACT-184: Third-party retry/circuit breaker. Owner: Rina. ETA: 2026-04-05.

DevOpsBot: reminder: any ACT without owner in 48h will be assigned to oncall.

Marta: adding that each ticket should include a "recurrence reason" field (options: config-drift, capacity-surge, pipeline-bug, external-flaky).

Luis: will prototype pre-warm and share perf numbers by Fri.

Owen: will post warmup benchmark this afternoon.

Rina: I'll create ENG tickets and link them here. scheduling a 30m follow-up next Tue to review PRs. thanks. :white_check_mark:
